beats.event: Winston rewrites history at the Ministry of Truth
Secretly hates the Party; the diary already condemns him
Buys a diary from Charrington and writes forbidden thoughts
Julia slips him a love note; they begin a secret affair
They meet in the rented room above Charrington's shop
O'Brien invites him in, presents himself as the Brotherhood
Reads Goldstein's forbidden book on the Party's rule
Thought Police storm the room; Charrington was their agent
In the Ministry of Love, starved and tortured for months
In Room 101 begs the rats be used on Julia instead
Released, drinking alone at the Chestnut Tree Café
Meets Julia; each admits betraying the other
He finally accepts that he loves Big Brother
